interestingFact: There are 195 countries in the world today, including 193 United Nations member states and 2 observer states.
Japan is made up of over 6,800 islands and is famous for its advanced technology and rich cultural heritage.
India is the world's most populous country and is home to the iconic Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World.
Canada has the longest coastline in the world, stretching over 243,000 kilometers.
Italy is home to the Colosseum and has more UNESCO World Heritage Sites than any other country.
South Africa has three official capital cities: Pretoria, Cape Town, and Bloemfontein.
Mexico introduced the world to chocolate, which originated from ancient Mesoamerican civilizations.
Norway is famous for its breathtaking fjords and is one of the best places to see the Northern Lights.
